card.name: Partway through warning terms
card.fires_on: Fires on the middle of words in warning text, such as 'hea' in Diarrhea after Clostridium difficile-associated, or 'ensitivity' and 'contr' in contraindication wording. Also fires on sentence-opening words in overdose or dosing instructions.
